title: Solar Battery
text: Solar batteries store excess electricity from photovoltaic panels for use when sunlight is unavailable.

title: Pumped Hydro
text: Pumped-storage hydroelectricity stores energy by pumping water to an upper reservoir; when demand rises, the water flows through turbines to generate electricity.

title: Molten Salt Storage
text: Concentrated solar power plants can store heat in molten salts and use it to generate electricity after sunset.

title: Flywheel Storage
text: Flywheel energy storage keeps energy in a spinning rotor and returns it as electricity when the rotor slows.
